moments.title: London Derbies Tonight

angles.copy: Forget Friday night plans, it's a double bill of London derbies in the Premier League. Who needs the points more?

angles.copy: Big news for Strictly fans: Amy Dowden is back on the dancefloor this weekend, partnering Kai Widdrington for Icons Week. What an emotional return!
